content.text: Perfect! This is a Next.js 16 app using the App Router. I'll create a middleware file to log every request to the console. In Next.js, middleware runs on every request and is perfect for request logging.

Done! I've created a middleware file at `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts` that will log every request to the console.

The middleware logs:
- Timestamp
- HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)
- Full URL
- User-Agent header
- IP address

The matcher config ensures it runs on all routes except Next.js internal static files and image optimization requests, which would clutter the logs.

You can start your dev server with `npm run dev` and you'll see request logs in the console for every page visit.
